answer_1.quote: We utilize open-source multimodal large language models (MLLM) and large language models (LLM) for the automated annotation of mined image pairs P = {(I q , I t i )}. Initially, each image pair (I q , I t i ) is processed by the MLLM to generate a detailed description D i of the common concepts and differences between the query image I q and the target image I t i . This description D i is then refined by the LLM to produce textual instructions T q→t i .
answer_1.outputs: textual instructions T q→t i describing transitions from query to target images

answer_2.quote: We evaluate Precision@1 for all tasks, which measures the ratio of positive candidates ranked in the top position for all queries. We report the average scores for the four meta tasks as well as the overall average.
